nodes.name: Finalize Response
nodes.notes: Creates the only item shape allowed to enter the final Respond node: status_code plus public_response.

nodes.name: Respond
nodes.notes: Architecture V2 uses this single Respond to Webhook node for every public outcome.

nodes.name: Execute Model Router V1
nodes.notes: After import, select Model Router V1. This node waits for one normalized result per input item.

parameters.content:
## Architecture V2 — Phase 4
The public endpoint accepts validated text or one Base64 PNG, JPEG, or WebP image. The image branch validates size, canonical Base64, and magic bytes before invoking Image Preprocessor V1. Only extracted text enters Model Router V1. Strict LLM validation, deterministic scoring, public response construction, and the single Respond node remain shared and unchanged.

nodes.name: Execute Image Preprocessor V1
nodes.notes: After import, select Image Preprocessor V1. The validated Base64 image is sent only to this sub-workflow.

nodes.name: Normalize Extracted Text
nodes.notes: Converts extracted text into the existing analysis context and omits Base64 before Model Router V1.
